verdict.rationale: The changelog says HOTP entries exist as a token type in Ente Auth (sharing is hidden for them), so counter-based tokens are supported. The rest of the story has no evidence. missing for 10: Steam Guard token support, custom period configuration, custom digit-length configuration, HOTP counter handling details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: Sharing is now limited to TOTP codes; the share option is hidden for HOTP entries.
